ruling.recommended_action: Refer to Ryde Trust & Safety for human review of the harassment/sexual-remark allegation; preserve trip record and any driver statement; contact rider with RydeHELP reporting path and advise 995 / police if she wishes to report; take no fare action pending the review.
ruling.reasoning:
SAFETY SCREEN: The dispute type is safety and the rider's complaint alleges the driver "kept making comments about my body and asked for my number," stating she "felt harassed and unsafe." Unwanted sexual advances and harassment fall squarely within Ryde's Code of Conduct prohibitions (SAFE-1), and Ryde's code bars "abuse of any kind." The driver's statement [F4] denies anything inappropriate, but a denial does not neutralise the allegation — the screening rule requires escalation, not adjudication, whenever such content appears; the record contains no in-app chat [F3], so there is no contemporaneous text to read, and the driver's version is a statement, not system evidence. Accordingly I do not rule on the merits.

Evidence status: the complaint is a statement, there is no chat record [F3], and there is no GPS/timeline evidence bearing on the alleged conduct — the rider's account is a narrative, not a fact-table entry, and the only other record is the driver's denial [F4]. Because the determinative material is a one-side statement with no report to verify, this is "unknown" evidence for a merits ruling and the case must go to a human reviewer regardless.

The route facts are unrelevant to this dispute and are recorded only for completeness: actual distance 17.1 km vs optimal 17.2 km (-0.1 km, -0%) [F1] shows no route deviation, and the duration overrun of 2.2 min [F2] is minor. The fare is a fixed RydeX quote, unaffected by mileage, so no FARE/RD refund basis exists. Profiles [F5][F6] show no prior disputes or upheld violations on either side and a clean driver record; profile facts cannot decide a case and I do not use them to discount the rider's account. No refund or fee action is taken at this stage; the file is escalated with the above factual summary for Trust & Safety.
